question: In Formula 1 seasons since 2001, considering only drivers who scored points in a season, which five constructors have had the most seasons where their drivers scored the fewest total points among all point-scoring drivers in that season?
sql:
-- Final result: top 5 constructors with most seasons having the fewest total points among point-scoring constructors since 2001
WITH constructor_season_points AS (
    SELECT r.year, rc.constructor_id, rc.name, SUM(res.points) as total_points
    FROM results res
    JOIN races r ON res.race_id = r.race_id
    JOIN constructors rc ON res.constructor_id = rc.constructor_id
    WHERE r.year >= 2001
    GROUP BY r.year, rc.constructor_id, rc.name
),
point_scoring_constructors AS (
    SELECT * FROM constructor_season_points
    WHERE total_points > 0
),
ranked_by_fewest AS (
    SELECT *,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points ASC) as rn
    FROM point_scoring_constructors
)
SELECT name, COUNT(*) as num_seasons
FROM ranked_by_fewest
WHERE rn = 1
GROUP BY name
ORDER BY num_seasons DESC, name ASC
LIMIT 5
